verdict.rationale: SerpApi offers a 'ZeroTrace Mode' that explicitly avoids storing search parameters/files/data, addressing retention proactively, and also documents a Searches Archive API and caching behavior (1h expiry) which implies some default retention/lifecycle control. However, there's no documented user-facing deletion mechanism, no data export/erasure API, and no detail on default retention periods outside ZeroTrace mode. Missing for 10: explicit data deletion/export controls, default retention policy documentation, and independent confirmation of ZeroTrace behavior in practice.
